function: Automatic search (PC-DARTS NAS) of the decoder architecture of a single-sided CSI feedback network that reconstructs angular-delay CSI from compressed, quantized codewords (p. 1, 3, 6).
system: FDD-OFDM, BS with 32-antenna ULA, single-antenna UEs; QuaDRiGa 2.655 GHz, 512 subcarriers; COST2100 5.3 GHz indoor, 300 MHz outdoor, 1024 subcarriers; 20 MHz; no RIS (p. 10).
method: Differentiable NAS (PC-DARTS) with bi-level optimization over a cell-based search space for the CS-CsiNet decoder; early stopping and elastic selection; candidates retrained from scratch; supervised MSE (p. 6-10).
data_channel: QuaDRiGa scenes 1 and 2 (3GPP 38.901 UMi-LOS, UMi-NLOS; 100,000 samples) and published COST2100 indoor and outdoor datasets (150,000 samples), each split into train, validation, test (p. 10).
test_conditions: Searched and trained per scenario at CR 1/4, B=8 by default; tested on held-out split of the same scenario; CR and B varied at evaluation (p. 10, 12).
baselines: Manually designed CS-CsiNet, CS-CsiNet+, CS-CRNet, CS-MRFNet, CS-SimpleCNN (all learned); no classical baseline such as compressed sensing or codebook (p. 12, 14).
metrics: NMSE (dB); cell FLOPs; running time per sample; average spectral efficiency with ZF precoding; search and evaluation GPU time (p. 10-13).
complexity: Cell FLOPs 0.90-6.07 M for Auto-CsiNet N1-N6 versus 1.62-7.78 M for manual cells; runtime 4.36e-2 to 5.04e-2 s per sample; search 0.4-1.0 GPU days (p. 12).
q1_support: p. 10: "The first two QuaDRiGa datasets were simulated using QuaDRiGa software [42], and the last two COST2100 datasets were simulated using COST2100 simulation software [31]"; Table III lists 3GPP-38.901-UMi-LOS/NLOS.
q2_support: p. 13: "The proposed scheme is effective even if there is a small deviation in the settings of CR" is shown by retraining each candidate (p. 12: "a dozen sub-networks to be trained"); no trained network is tested in another scenario.
q3_support: p. 12: "we compare the performance of Auto-CsiNet with that of CS-CsiNet [12], CS-CsiNet+ [22], CS-CRNet [24] and CS-MRFNet [26]" are all learned; no non-learned method is compared on NMSE or rate.
q4_support: p. 13: "running time per sample (testing on a Tesla V100 GPU with a batchsize of 1)"; Table V (p. 12) also lists the cell FLOPs of each network.
q5_support: p. 2: "indoor/outdoor scene dataset (released by [12])" and p. 10: "published by [12]"; the COST2100 datasets are public, but no link is given and the QuaDRiGa data are self-simulated.
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match. Area 2 because the learned decoder reconstructs CSI; the NAS only designs its architecture. q5 rests on the COST2100 datasets published by [12] and the reviewer should confirm it. q2 is not met because architectures are retrained for each scenario, CR and B. Tables I-VI and Fig. 5, 7, 8 were read from page images.
